profile.summary: Passionate about Developer Productivity and AI, I specialize in crafting innovative tools and frameworks that empower engineers.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, AI Automations
positions.description:
Tech Lead, Mae Reviews
* Led the team that built automated AI code reviews at LI scale. Infra scaled up to review 3K commits/hour, 5 mins median response time with acceptance rate ~60%.

Tech Lead, AI Evaluations
* Led the AI Evaluations team, whose harness/model/plugin benchmarks set the standard coding stack used company-wide at LinkedIn

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Build Infra
positions.description:
Part of the small team that is tasked to design and migrate LinkedIn's 15000+ Micro-services to a few large Macro-repos.

• In charge of designing the metrics and providing Insights for this project. Through cluster analysis, proposed division of repos based on tech-stack and minimize cross-repo dependencies.
•  Designed and implemented both Bazel and Go publishers.

Tech Lead, Bazel Dependency Infrastructure
•  Designed & implemented a system that incorporates both Bazel and Internal registries; allowing publishing and serving at scale. Registry currently serves 50+ bazel repos, 200 developers, and 100K+ builds per month.
•  Designed a system that automatically brings external dependencies into Linkedin's Bazel ecosystem during build time. Within the first week of launch, the system brought over 100+ external dependencies into the Bazel ecosystem, reducing local build failures due to missing dependencies by 30%, and saved over 1000+ dev hours of manual dependency management.

Agentic Improvements:
•  Improved our custom model for build fixing by running Evals to identify patterns that can be resolved by continuously learning from ongoing on-call issues. Improved fix rate by 15%. 
•  Guided an intern to make an on-call agent that solved 20% of our on-call load. This saves 1000+ dev hours annually.
• Launched a migration effort that involved converting WORKSPACE to MODULE.bazel in order to roll out Bazel 8. Within the first week of the effort, I converted 20+ repos with 80% reduction in migration time.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer, Developer Insights
positions.description:
Founding member of Developer Insights at LinkedIn. Help develop the Insights Data Management Strategy for analytics and metrics design across the software development lifecycle. Owned Deployment and Build Metrics design and instrumentation. 

• Collaborated across engineering, working with build platforms, code collaboration, CI, deployment, client frameworks, and product teams. Full-stack development with frontend, backend, data pipeline, and data science engineers. 
•  Insights and contributions led to a 36% decrease in build times, 41% reduction in time spent in code review, and 21% decrease in post-merge CI duration, while simultaneously increasing developer satisfaction by 17% and reducing member-experienced issues by 15%.
•  Lead the team Anomaly detection and root cause analysis space. Applied techniques like Time Based multi-dimensional analysis using FPGrowth to identify root causes across all developer productivity metrics. This system helped reduce investigation time by ~50%.

•  Built Internal knowledge Search & Generation solution (RAG). Built an automated data pipeline for consuming and storing thousands of documents from Piwik, Wiki, Jira, Stack Overflow & Slack into vector DB. Built scalable Inference infra, slack bot, and internal chat interface. The prototype became viral internally; 500+ daily active users, 3K daily queries within a week of unannounced launch.

•  Built a command line tool that can run any internal CLI command based on natural language prompts. The tool used help snippets from over 200 internal CLIs and past usages as examples. It won "The Dream Big" award and got showcased by the CEO during all hands. The tools showed 50% increase success rate compare to directly using the CLIs.

positions.title: Software Engineer #1 / Employee #2
positions.description:
Technical ownership of all HealthLevel product platforms with oversight of all engineers on staff that included interns, contract engineers, and app developers. In addition, expanded role included defining product features based on customer inputs, provide technical guidance and propose solutions for customers in sales meetings. 

•    Developed strategies to overcome technical or architectural challenges within existing or new customers.
*    Developed continuous integration system that sped up development cycles and increased quality, efficiency and sanity of production releases. (Jenkins, Python, s3, EC2).
•    Built REST API layer that expanded product platform from web-only to mobile platforms and enabled customers/partners to collaborate (C#, Postman)
•    Lead an offshore team to build mobile platforms that produced beta versions of the two apps in 4 months. (IOS, Android)
•    Integration and release manager. (Git, Xcode, iTunes Connect)

positions.title: Sr. Systems Programmer
positions.description:
Part of the team that develops and maintains the Gracenote music and video recognition service. Day to day tasks include development,service configuration work, code push integrations, code and kit builds & sustaining task such as performance testing, bug reproduction, and small research projects.

Major Projects:

High performance distributed cache
Designed and Implemented persistent in-memory key-value store for user sessions. Cache is capable of distributing data among local nodes as well as remote nodes. (C, MongoDB)

Music Discovery & Radio platform ( Gracenote Rhythm )
Co-Implemented radio and music discovery service that served personalized recommendations & create radio stations based on artists, genre, mood, tempo etc. (C)(http://www.gracenote.com/music/music-discovery/)
